neet_che_u02_t05_1.working: H-hat is the Hamiltonian operator, which represents the total energy of the system (kinetic + potential).

neet_che_u02_t05_2.working: In hydrogen the energy depends only on n, so orbitals with the same n are degenerate: 2s and 2p.

neet_che_u02_t05_3.working: In multi-electron atoms the 2s electron penetrates closer to the nucleus and is less shielded, so 2s lies lower than 2p.

neet_che_u02_t05_4.working: A (H-hat) = total energy operator (II); B (psi) = wave function with no physical meaning by itself (IV); C (|psi|^2) = probability density (I); D (orbital) = region of maximum probability (III).

neet_che_u02_t05_5.working: A is true (quantised energies). B is true (n, l, m_l arise from the solutions). C is false (no exact path, by the uncertainty principle). D is false (hydrogen energy depends only on n). E is true. So A, B and E.
